breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the user's erroneous instruction to set the free-end rotation to zero. Instead, it asks to compute the slope (rotation) at the free end, which is the correct approach for a cantilever beam under a point load and aligns with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to use a constant moment of PL over the full span. The generated specification provides the standard formula for deflection, δ = (P L³) / (3 E I), which is derived from the correct, linearly varying moment distribution, thereby fixing the error and matching the intent of the ground truth.
